kaikki_vikisozluk.e: رِضَا النَّاسِ غَايَةٌ لَا تُدْرَكُ • (riḍā n-nāsi ḡāyatun lā tudraku)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Ibn Abī-l-Ḥadīd attrtibutes it to ʿAlī in his book شرح نهج البلاغة. It literally means "People's acceptance is a goal that cannot be reached".
g: It is impossible to make a decision that is accepted by every single person; pleasing and appeasing everyone is a goal that cannot be reached.
